story.title: Good Luck Meets Fearless Grit
story.part1: Moya Caps was forged at the intersection of superstition and streetwear culture. The horseshoe turned upright catches blessings; the four-leaf clover defies the odds; the devil with his pitchfork ensures you never back down from a challenge.
story.part2: Every cap is crafted from custom-dyed premium heavyweight cotton twill, built with structured crown reinforcement to maintain its aggressive shape year after year.
story.stat1Desc: Dense multi-layered puff embroidery with zero loose threads.
story.stat2Desc: Carefully curated crown & visor color contrasts + Trucker options.
story.stat3Desc: Reinforced internal buckram ensuring enduring crown structure.
story.pillarFortuneDesc: Horseshoe & 4-leaf clover to attract unyielding prosperity.
story.pillarAudacityDesc: Twin pitchfork devil embroidery for those who dare to stand out.

anatomy.title: The Anatomy of 0880
anatomy.subtitle: Scroll to deconstruct the architecture behind every Moya Cap.
anatomy.layer1Desc: Over 38,000 stitches creating tactile, razor-sharp front embroidery.

anatomy.layer3Desc: Rear custom 0880 arch embroidery over a 7-hole adjustable snapback.
anatomy.layer4Desc: Internal buckram structuring guarantees an uncrushable high profile.
